SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('/grap/user/content/detail/', content_id) AS path, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(update_dt, create_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_modified, 'weekly' AS change_frequency, '0.8' AS priority FROM content WHERE is_published = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('/grap/user/content/festivals/', id) AS path, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(updated_at, written_date, created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_modified, 'weekly' AS change_frequency, '0.8' AS priority FROM festivals WHERE is_show = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('/grap/user/content/exhibitions/', id) AS path, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(updated_at, created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_modified, 'weekly' AS change_frequency, '0.8' AS priority FROM exhibitions WHERE is_show = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('/grap/user/content/welfare/', id) AS path, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(updated_at, created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_modified, 'monthly' AS change_frequency, '0.7' AS priority FROM welfare_services WHERE is_show = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('/grap/user/content/gas-stations/', id) AS path, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(updated_at, created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_modified, 'daily' AS change_frequency, '0.7' AS priority FROM gas_stations ) sitemap_urls WHERE path IS NOT NULL AND last_modified IS NOT NULL ORDER BY path
